M-SYNTAX.Purpose: Parse child-owned `parents` declarations from the file-leading comment area of any text file.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Leading declaration area of declaration-capable files across supported comment syntaxes.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Recognized preludes: UTF-8 BOM, shebang, XML prolog, frontmatter, DOCTYPE, INI headers.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Declaration-like text after the leading comment area ends.

Requirements.REQ-001: `parents` is the only supported semantic-edge declaration; legacy `children:` produces an explicit syntax diagnostic and no edge.
Requirements.REQ-002: Parse order: skip recognized preludes, then leading comment/header area only; later declaration-like text is ignored.
Requirements.REQ-003: Comment syntax comes from the file extension when recognized, otherwise from the actual leading comment marker (`<!--`, `//`, `#`, `--`).
Requirements.REQ-004: A binary file (NUL byte in the leading area) never participates.
Requirements.REQ-005: No declaration is a valid no-op; a declaration holder participates even when used only as a graph-discovery seed.
Requirements.REQ-006: Duplicate canonical edges are idempotent; selector order is retained where topology does not constrain order.

Inputs.IN-001: Leading area bytes of a candidate file.
